skills.description: Rachel Maddow's Blowout — an executable toolkit that exposes how the oil and gas industry corrupts democracy, empowers authoritarian regimes, and drives environmental destruction, with lessons from Russia, the US, and across the developing world. Related skills: bad-blood (investigative journalism), blood-and-oil (geopolitics), black-edge (financial crimes), clear-thinking-book (critical thinking).
